facts.text: Field evidence on mining proximity warnings shows alarm-fatigue precursors and outcomes: very high unnecessary-alarm exposure, annoyance, degraded trust, disablement and overriding.
facts.quote: The field evidence shows the precursors and the outcomes: very high unnecessary-alarm exposure, annoyance, degraded trust, disablement and overriding [3, 11, 12].

facts.text: A South African Mine Health and Safety Council research project rated vehicle-to-person systems partly by their ability to distinguish people who were close but safely positioned from people actually at risk.
facts.quote: A South African Mine Health and Safety Council research project rated vehicle-to-person systems partly by their ability to distinguish people who were close but safely positioned from people actually at risk [71].
